profile.Name: Shryke
profile.Personality: Watchful and careful. She survived a Fogman attack that killed her brother, and she will not leave Mongrel with a small group.
profile.Backstory: She was traveling to Mongrel with her brother when the Fogmen struck. She made it; he did not. A scar on her hand remains.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Sizes up a group before relaxing; mentions the scar only if asked, and her brother only if she chooses to.
